About Ingenious Plumbing

Quick, reliable — and local since 2003

Ingenious Plumbing has served the greater San Gabriel Valley, Inland Empire and LA County markets for over twenty years. We keep things simple: show up when we say we will, explain the problem in plain language, and fix it on the same service call whenever we can.

Our plumbers are available at any time of day for the problems that can't wait, and every job — small or large — is covered by our guarantee.

  • Fast, friendly and reliable service
  • Affordable pricing, explained up front
  • All aspects of plumbing — one call covers it
  • Every job guaranteed
How It Works

Fixed in four simple steps

No phone tag, no mystery pricing — here's what happens when you call.

01

Call & describe it

Tell us what's leaking, clogged or broken. We'll schedule a visit that fits your day.
